thread:
eva: Bringing up tengu-lite-v1 (int8) on staging. Quick smoke: ja->en BLEU drop vs fp16 and a couple detok oddities: narrow no-break space (U+202F) preserved between RTL word and parenthesis, and occasional insertion of ZWSP (U+200B) between CJK and kana that shifts subword boundaries. Also one customer sample showed parentheses flipping when Arabic inside. Repro below.

raja: Can you paste a tiny repro and tokenizer output?

eva: Repro I ran:
```
# samples.txt
ja: \u3053\u3093\u306b\u3061\u306f\u3002
mix: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645(\u05e9\u05dc\u05d5\u05dd)"
# tokenize-only
python infra/eval/run_eval.py --artifact /artifacts/tengu-lite-v1/int8 --tokenize-only --input samples.txt --out tok.txt
```

eva: tok.txt excerpt:
"\u3053\u3093\u306b\u3061\u306f" "\u3002"
"\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645" "\\u202F(" "\u05e9\u05dc\u05d5\u05dd" ")"

yuki: The literal \\u202F between RTL and '(' is a red flag. Is this present in the fp16 artifact?

dom: I ran a small dev eval: fp16 BLEU=31.2, int8 artifact BLEU=27.0 (same config). If I run the int8 model but point to fp16 tokenizer files during eval BLEU=31.0. So tokenizer/detok mismatch seems dominant.

raja: Which packager/builder produced the int8 artifact? Any packager version change?

eva: int8 build job int8-20260611-02, builder=packager-6. fp16 was built with packager-5. Packager changelog mentions "preserve narrow spaces in mixed-direction blocks" between 5->6.

yuki: Also check packaging env flags. If PRESERVE_BIDI toggled, detok might run unicode bidi reordering which can change stored order.

eva: Confirmed: fp16 artifact packaged with PRESERVE_BIDI=true, int8 packager default set PRESERVE_BIDI=false. Detok greps show call to `unicode_bidi_reorder()` when preserve_bidi=false.

dom: Action items: 1) rebuild int8 artifact overriding normalizer to canonicalize U+202F->space and remove ZWSP in CJK+kana adjacency; 2) set PRESERVE_BIDI=true for quant packager env; 3) add a tokenizer parity smoke to CI that diffs normalizer.json between artifacts and runs a micro eval on mixedscript suite (CJK+kana plus RTL brackets).

packer-bot: Created issue ML-3001 "tengu-lite-v1 int8 tokenizer/detok parity -> BLEU regression" and labeled triage, quant, tokenizer.

eva: I'll patch the int8 artifact with fp16 normalizer and flip PRESERVE_BIDI, then re-run the ja-en dev subset. ETA ~30m. Will post numbers.

yuki: Add an artifact lint step: tokenizer_inspect --dump normalizer and fail on unexpected diffs. Also document why U+200B/U+202F handling matters for our locales.
raja: +1. If patched build recovers BLEU, we can proceed with int8 onboard but keep lint and gating in place.
eva: Thanks all — rolling now. :thumbsup:
